subject: music
title: Tempo Words
welcome_lead: Slow, medium, fast — and the Italian terms for them.
meta_desc: KS3 tempo: Italian terms, BPM ranges, common labels.
final_note: Composers use Italian to label the speed.

walkthroughs.body_html: Adagio (slow) and Largo (very slow) suit funeral marches, lullabies and emotional pieces. The pulse sits around 50-70 BPM.
Andante literally means 'walking'. Moderato is a touch quicker. Most songs sit somewhere around these tempos.
Allegro (lively) is the most common fast tempo. Presto is extremely fast — think of a chase scene or a flamenco finale.
